_comment: Series → TestRail/Confluence/Code program mapping. Drives bootstrap-brain-series.js and parameterized ingest scripts.
_aliasComment: programAliases maps ticket-mentioned program names → the canonical program folder that actually carries the automation. Aliases are SKIPPED during code-scan to avoid scanning equivalent codebases multiple times.
_pressTypeComment: programPressType classifies each PROGRAM as a web (roll/roll-fed) or sheetfed (sheet-fed) press. Values confirmed by domain expert 2026-06-11. Allowed: 'web' | 'sheetfed'. Consumed by scripts/build-component-inventory.js → component_registry.press_type. Distinguishing hardware: web presses have RW+UW (rewinder/unwinder) and a WHS (Web Handling System); sheetfed presses have a feeder and a stacker.
_pressDomainComment: Authoritative press domain model (domain expert, 2026-06-11). Drives press-aware test generation: which components exist for a given press type / series / program, and the ink-path transfer model. Consumed by the generation enrichment to ground tests in real hardware.

firstTransferComponent._comment: Component that holds ink for the FIRST transfer (T1). S6 uses ASID; all other series use PIP.

firstTransferComponentNotes.ASID: aSID — Amorphous Silicon Drum (photoconductor); first-transfer ink carrier on S6 (per David/Kedem overview)
firstTransferComponentNotes.PIP: Photo Imaging Plate — first-transfer ink carrier (photoconductor) on S3/S4

inkTransferModel.T1: First transfer: ink moves from the first-transfer component (ASID on S6 / PIP otherwise) to the Blanket.
inkTransferModel.T2: Second transfer: ink moves from the Blanket to the substrate.

_opcuaProgramsComment: Programs using UA Expert + gInterface/OPCUAInterface stack. S6 = all; S3 = Gamla (a.k.a. 6K+) only. Other S3 programs do not use OPCUA stack.

s4._alias: S4 and S5 are the same pipeline — single key `s4`, TestRail project 807, same programs, same Confluence labels (S4 | S4/5 | S5)
s4._programsNote: All folders scanned — hash dedup in codeEmbeddings handles shared content. programAliases resolves ticket→canonical for brain filtering / series detection only. Canonicals: Arad (⇐Hila,Yael), Barak (⇐Sufa,Storm), Ayala (⇐Shani,Friend), Tamar (⇐Arava). Amit listed but no top-level folder yet — scan-code-for-series.js warn-skips.
s4._s4SystemSourceComment: The authoritative S4 system overview is the local confidential PDF (data/source-docs/s4-press-overview.txt) ingested via scripts/ingest-s4-overview.js → data/brain/systems-s4.json. There is NO S4 Confluence page. systemUrls is intentionally [] (it previously WRONGLY held the S6 page 'Series-6+Press+Machines+Overview', which polluted the S4 brain with S6 data).

s3._suiteMapComment: S3 project 808 splits tests per machine model. Map ticket program → suite name. Suite IDs resolved at runtime via TestRail get_suites (name→id). Cross-cutting suites (ATP, Automation Regressions, E2E, Manual Regressions, PC & Windows, PrC, POS) are NOT program-bound.
s3._programsNote: User spelled 'Gefen' — actual folder is 'Geffen' (double f). Using correct spelling.
s3._s3SystemSourceComment: S3 has the same HW components as S4 but DIFFERENT SW (domain expert 2026-07-06): S3 has NO PEX — IO injection is via SysTab / IO Editor only, configuration changes (new HW / new configurations) via the Press Configuration tool. The PEX component entry is removed from systems-s3.json and promptBuilder + TDR (S3) carry the tooling override. S3 reuses the S4 system knowledge for the shared HW components: data/brain/systems-s3.json is aliased from systems-s4.json (321 components, sourced from data/source-docs/s4-press-overview.txt). systemUrls is intentionally [] — it previously WRONGLY held the S6 page 'Series-6+Press+Machines+Overview', which would pollute the S3 brain with S6 data on any re-ingest. EXCEPTION: Gamla (6K+) behaves like S6 and uses TMC/OPCUA signals; that grounding comes from data/brain/tmc-signals-s3.json via isOpcuaProgram('s3','Gamla'), NOT from this systems KB, so it is unaffected by this alias.

autonomous._product: AutoX / Autonomous — automated operations performed instead of a human technician, SW-only or HW+SW (AMC/AMR executers, Press Orchestrator, KB components, RMS Gateway, PQ RCA). NOT a press and NOT DFE: intentionally absent from programPressType / pressDomain / opcuaPrograms so generation enrichment skips press grounding.
autonomous._projectIdNote: TestRail project not assigned yet — set the real project id here to enable uploads for this series.

ramon._product: DFE (Digital Front End) — Ramon code solution (repo Automation_Tests_Ramon). NOT a press: intentionally absent from programPressType / pressDomain / opcuaPrograms so generation enrichment skips press grounding. Code repo cloned to C:\Ramon (CODE_REPO_ROOT=C:\, program=Ramon).
